item.q: Hurry up! If you miss the bus, you ___ ___ late.
item.why: First conditional: *if* + present simple (*miss*), *will* + base verb (*will be*). *would be* goes with *if you missed*.
item.why_lv: First conditional: *if* + Present Simple (*miss*), *will* + pamatforma (*will be*). *would be* iet kopā ar *if you missed*.
